in_sanskrit.name: उज्वला
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'ujj' meaning 'to burn' and the suffix 'vala' meaning 'to flow'. The name Ujwala refers to something that is constantly burning and glowing, like a lamp. It is also an auspicious name, signifying good fortune and prosperity.
